purpose: Development test of Selective Handover: which parts of the teacher's estimate the student needs, and whether a per-input method built on that beats existing handovers

algorithm.draft: S = eps + g(eps, 0), one student pass; eps independent of the teacher's noise (seed + 1009)
algorithm.decomposition: on generated frames, voice = per-band mean over time; slow = centred moving average over 9 frames of the remainder, with edge padding; fine = the rest; x = voice + slow + fine
algorithm.handover: each part comes from the teacher's guided estimate T or from S, named by three letters (voice, slow, fine); prompt frames unchanged; the released student loop at j = 1 then runs from x
algorithm.ladder: rung i of ['plain_4', 'STT_4', 'STT_5', 'STT_6', 'STT_7'] is used if prompt SNR >= base - gap * i; otherwise the reference at Step 8

reused: plain Steps 4 to 8 from EXP-018 steps1to8.csv and student only from EXP-017 grid32.csv (standing in for SSS, with its own noise draw); same seeds and T4 hardware

data.quality: first 60 development speakers by utterance ID x ['clean', 'noisy15', 'gauss18', 'gauss20', 'gauss22', 'gauss25']
data.diversity: first 20 development speakers, clean prompt, 20 seeds (input_seed + 1000 + m)

hardware: Colab Tesla T4 only, enforced by the runner: student noise depends on the GPU and the labels are T4 labels

failure_rule.description: Definition 3.1 Unacceptable Added Degradation Failure Thresholds

diversity_measure.name: CVf0 (DMOSpeech 2, Section 4.2)
diversity_measure.f0: librosa.pyin fmin 65.0 fmax 500.0 frame 1024 hop 256 at 24 kHz
diversity_measure.definition: per frame std/mean (ddof 1) of f0 across seeds, over frames voiced in at least 0.5 of the seeds; averaged over frames; then over pairs
diversity_measure.note: the paper gives no formula, seed handling or voicing rule; these are this study's choices

ladder.procedure: one fixed-sequence Learn-Then-Test chain over the base cut-off per gap, delta split equally across chains (Bonferroni); the cheapest certified pair is selected

primary_hypothesis: taking the voice part from the student's draft (STT) is what reduces noisy-prompt failures; the other five mixed combinations form the descriptive map and are not selected on these data

criteria.C1_noisy_failures: noisy pooled, STT_4 vs plain_4: failures at most 0.75 of plain_4, fewer, and exact McNemar p < 0.05
criteria.C2_clean_failures: clean, STT_4 failures at most plain_4 failures + 1
criteria.C3_voice_is_the_cause: noisy pooled, speaker-bootstrap 95% CI of the main effect of taking the voice part from the student on similarity (all 8 combinations at Step 4): lower bound > 0
criteria.C4_diversity: CVf0 95% CI, STT_4 - student only lower bound > 0, and STT_4 - plain_4 lower bound > -0.02
criteria.C5_beats_calibrated_snr: out-of-fold ladder: lower mean passes than snr_theta with no more failures
criteria.C6_beats_ladder_without_selection: out-of-fold ladder: lower mean passes than ladder_plain with no more failures

decision_rule: Selective Handover advances to a frozen test on fresh speakers only if C1 to C6 all pass; otherwise it is reported as a negative result, with no retuning on these data. The effect map is reported either way
evidence_status: development evidence; the speakers were inspected before this design; not the thesis's frozen held-out evaluation (EVAL-001/EVAL-002)
adoption: not adopted; replacing the thesis method needs a dated decision record and adviser review
